name: comparative_adjective
description: Form the English comparative of an adjective in a few-shot mapping (e.g. 'tall -> taller, cold -> colder, fast ->' -> ' faster'). Control: same few-shot format but identity mapping (word copied unchanged).
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
A={'tall':'taller','short':'shorter','fast':'faster','slow':'slower','big':'bigger','small':'smaller','old':'older','young':'younger','cold':'colder','hot':'hotter','long':'longer','high':'higher','low':'lower','strong':'stronger','weak':'weaker','rich':'richer','poor':'poorer','dark':'darker','light':'lighter','hard':'harder','soft':'softer','large':'larger','deep':'deeper','wide':'wider','thin':'thinner','fat':'fatter','warm':'warmer','cheap':'cheaper','loud':'louder','quiet':'quieter','happy':'happier','easy':'easier','early':'earlier','heavy':'heavier','good':'better','bad':'worse','near':'nearer','safe':'safer','clean':'cleaner','sharp':'sharper'}
ks=list(A)
items=[];ctrl=[]
for t in ks:
    for r in range(3):
        shots=random.sample([k for k in ks if k!=t],3)
        items.append({'prompt':', '.join(f'{s} -> {A[s]}' for s in shots)+f', {t} ->','answer':' '+A[t]})
        ctrl.append({'prompt':', '.join(f'{s} -> {s}' for s in shots)+f', {t} ->','answer':' '+t})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':ctrl},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
